not_covered.text: Ethiopian forces regain control of Adigrat in the Tigray Region following a withdrawal of Eritrean forces. Celebrations are reported in the city following the withdrawal.
Simon strengthens into a category 4 Pacific hurricane with 150 mph (240 kph) in winds as it barrels towards Mexico's coast.
A man is killed after jumping into a tiger enclosure and being attacked at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in South Yorkshire, England.

Indian authorities are placing New Delhi under an intense security lockdown and have been detaining thousands of demonstrators to block a massive rally that is being organized by the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party.
In cycling, the 120th edition of the Giro di Lombardia is held, with Paul Seixas winning the race and becoming the youngest person to do so.
